Subject: Summit Bottles are back — 2 left
Preview: 750 ml, 24-hour cold, double-wall stainless. They went fast last time.
Body: You checked on the Summit Bottle before. It's back in stock — barely.

Two units remain.

A quick rundown for the trip you're planning:

• 750 ml capacity — enough for a solid half-day push without a refill stop
• Double-wall stainless steel construction keeps drinks cold for 24 hours, hot for 12
• Built for day hikes, long approaches, and packed lunches — not designed as a filter or a cookpot

No discount. No pitch. Just a heads-up that stock is thin and these have moved quickly both times they've been available.

If it fits your kit, now's the time to grab it.
